intent: Policy-only revision: PA12 design basis with SLS/MJF undecided, a nominal340mm local/oriented limit for every print/coupon, explicit reasons for necessary separations, and provisional SLS-reference mass density. No geometry, fasteners, fits, datums or qualification changes.

runtime_document_labels.scope: FreeCAD replaces the document Label with the source filename stem when opening these saved files. Serialized labels are compared independently; this is not a native object-label exception.

Notes.before: PA12 SLS preferred, MJF alternative; one-piece target 340x32x7mm; export oriented45deg inXY for size screening. Confirm process and one-piece acceptance with supplier before ordering. Single-sided tape covers each exposed lateral wing and extends onto balloon. Do not cover the central T head. Unbroken1.2mm base;13.5mm head lands separated by4.5mm flex reliefs at18mm pitch with0.5mm web-root fillets. Shoe bridges the narrow gaps. Clamp only on a full land, preferably within+/-4mm of its centre, with the whole shoe supported (centre |X| <= 161mm). Curvature and tape grip require a physical trial. No printed rail lock pins. The1.2mm narrow base is an intentional flexure: it exceeds generic0.8mm nylon minimum but is NOT blanket compliance with the3mm long/broad PA12 recommendation. Supplier review and physical curvature/tape trial required.

PA12_density_assumption.basis: Provisional reference from Creallo's published SLS PA12 data, not a verified density for the eventual SLS/MJF grade or lot. Actual printed and finished parts remain unweighed.

current_manufacturing_policy.material: PA12 design basis; supplier grade/process/finish agreement pending
current_manufacturing_policy.part_size_rule: Each local part bounding-box dimension before print rotation and each oriented export dimension must be at most 340 mm. Apply to every installed print and coupon; additionally screen oriented exports against both published process envelopes. This nominal CAD limit is not a guarantee of delivered dimensions.
current_manufacturing_policy.rationale: PA12 is Creallo's documented functional powder-bed nylon and suits open integral supports and the rail flexure trial. Neither SLS nor MJF is established as superior for this assembly; choose with the supplier using fit, stiffness, straightness and mass requirements. A material/process change requires renewed fit and flexure qualification.
current_manufacturing_policy.supplier_process_policy: Creallo integrates SLS/MJF quotations and selects the process unless separately agreed. No process is preselected here. Confirm the actual PA12 grade, process and finish before printing matched coupons and full parts.
current_manufacturing_policy.size_guide_scope: Published maximum fabrication sizes include split-and-join manufacture. They are screening bounds, not guaranteed one-piece machine capacity or acceptance.
current_manufacturing_policy.qualification: Not qualified: obtain one-piece acceptance and review 1.2 mm functional flexures, straightness, curvature, fatigue and sliding fit. Use the same agreed process/material/finish for coupons and full parts.
current_manufacturing_policy.flexure_exception: The narrow 1.2 mm flexure is intentionally below the 1.5 mm general wall target; supplier review and full-length bend/fatigue testing remain mandatory. Longer 4.5 mm reliefs offset some added bending stiffness.
current_manufacturing_policy.dfam_basis: Prefer integral open ribs, windows and accessible through-features. SLS/MJF powder supports overhangs; do not introduce splits solely from FDM/SLA support-angle rules. Keep powder-removal access to holes and pockets. Do not add lattice infill or sealed hollow regions to these already open thin members; avoid extra fine struts and trapped powder.

continuous_motion_scope: This transition audit does not rerun full continuous collision certification. Identical saved local/world geometry, placements, hierarchy, numeric controls and expressions preserve the prior motion definition. The release pipeline separately reruns full native motion checks on the candidate.
supplier_fit_limitation: The340mm check is a nominal CAD limit, not delivered dimensional tolerance or guaranteed one-piece supplier acceptance. Existing tight fits, shaft float, flexures, manufacturing uncertainty and physical qualification obligations remain unchanged.

supplemental_final_release_axial_float_r.scope: Continuous separation of the audited installed solids across independently moving groups over the recorded angular domain, with each output Pod allowed the measured annular-stop axial travel. The free-clearance certificates subtract the sum of participating output travel magnitudes from the nominal distance lower bound. Two carrier/frame pairs retain their whole-pair nominal clearance certificates and require that bound to cover the full measured travel; zero residual clearance is allowed only at intentional annular-stop contact. The eight original functional interfaces remain separately classified, without a free-clearance or axial-float certificate. Same-group assembly contacts, flexible wires, unmodeled gear set screws/OEM retaining screws, manufacturing tolerance, and deformation are not certified.
